name: Vile Fin Scale
summary: Along Tirisfal’s northern coasts and waterways, Vile Fin Scale comes from the murloc tribes. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society studies these samples while seeking a plague to strike the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: Apothecary Reagents
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks a blight that can spread through the living and the Scourge. Simple toxins are easy to brew, but an infectious disease must pass from one population to another. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan studies Vile Fin scales for their natural resilience and mucous coatings. He hopes these traits will steady his experimental contagions and help them spread.

sections.title: The Coastline Menace
sections.body: The Vile Fin tribe lives along Tirisfal Glades’ northern shores and western shallows. Its members threaten travelers and press into Forsaken territory. Gathering their scales helps check the feral murloc population and gives Johaan’s laboratory fresh organic material for tests in biological warfare.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan want these scales?
aliases: what does johaan do with scales
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan studies Vile Fin scales for the Royal Apothecary Society’s work on a new plague. Ordinary poisons do not spread, so he studies the scales’ natural properties for help carrying his experiments from one population to another.

faq.q: Where can Vile Fin murlocs be found?
faq.answer: Vile Fin murlocs inhabit Tirisfal Glades’ coasts, especially the northern shoreline and western waters beside Brightwater Lake and the sea.

faq.q: What makes the New Plague project important to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Forsaken seek a weapon against their bitter rivals, the mindless Scourge and the living races who see them as monsters. Johaan’s work in Brill is an early effort toward that kingdom-wide aim.

faq.q: Which specific creatures carry these scales?
faq.answer: Vile Fin Minor Oracles, Muckdwellers, and Puddlejumpers of the Vile Fin tribe in Tirisfal carry these scales.

angles.text: As an undead, each Vile Fin scale you gather aids the Royal Apothecary Society in its duty to develop a weapon for Forsaken survival against the living and the Scourge.
As Horde, you help secure Tirisfal Glades’ outskirts for messengers and travelers when you clear aggressive coastal murloc settlements.
